const alive=()=>{try{return state.view==='world'&&state.sid==='s11'&&document.body.dataset.scene==='world'}catch(_){return false}};
const T=()=>period(60,12);
const html=`
 <div class="v030-room" aria-label="共振の広間：実際に遊べるステージ11">
  <div class="v030-scenery" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="v030-glow" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <canvas class="v030-pendulums" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
  <header class="v030-hall-head"><div class="v030-title"><div class="v030-overline">STAGE 11 · SCIENCE FANTASY</div><h2>共振の広間</h2><p>ふりこのリズムに合わせて、光を取り戻せ。</p></div>
  <div class="v030-actions"><button type="button" data-v030="hint" aria-expanded="false">✦ ヒント</button><button type="button" data-v030="original">☷ 元の実験画面</button><button type="button" data-v030="map">⌂ マップ</button></div></header>
  <div class="v030-signal" role="status" aria-live="off">揺れを観察しよう</div>
  <div class="v030-hintpanel" hidden><h3>科学のヒント</h3><p>振り子が真ん中を通る瞬間をねらって「ひと押し！」。<b>タイミングよく力を加える</b>と、揺れが大きくなるよ。<br><br>この装置の周期は約<span class="v030-period"></span>秒。振り子の重さではなく、長さと重力が主に周期を決めるよ。</p></div>
  <div class="v030-hall-bottom"><div class="v030-objective"><div class="v030-overline">MISSION / 観察と操作</div><strong>真ん中で4回、タイミングよく押そう</strong><span>「押す！」の合図でタップ。押した結果を観察しよう。</span></div>
   <button type="button" class="v030-push" data-v030="push">✋ ひと押し！<small>中央に来たときに押す</small></button>
   <div class="v030-results"><b class="v030-hit">成功 0 / 4</b><div class="v030-meter"><i></i></div><div class="v030-message" role="status" aria-live="polite">正しいリズムを見つけよう</div></div></div>
  <div class="v030-reward" hidden role="dialog" aria-modal="false" aria-label="共振の広間クリア"><div class="v030-overline">MISSION COMPLETE</div><h3>共振の広間 クリア！</h3><p>適切なタイミングで力を加えると、振り子の振幅が大きくなることを発見した！</p><div class="v030-overline">★★★</div><div style="margin-top:12px"><button type="button" data-v030="next">次のステージへ</button><button type="button" data-v030="replay">もう一度観察</button></div></div>
 </div>`;
function setOriginal(show){if(!mounted)return;const room=mounted.querySelector('.v030-room');const restore=mounted.querySelector('.v030-restore');mounted.classList.toggle('v030-open',!show);mounted.classList.toggle('v030-original',!!show);room.hidden=!!show;restore.hidden=!show;document.body.classList.toggle('v030-immersive',!show);}
function onClick(e){const b=e.target.closest('[data-v030]');if(!b)return;const action=b.dataset.v030;
 if(action==='map'){selectTab('map');return;}
 if(action==='hint'){const hint=mounted.querySelector('.v030-hintpanel'),isOpen=hint.hidden;hint.hidden=!isOpen;b.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(isOpen));return;}
 if(action==='original'){setOriginal(true);return;}
 if(action==='restore'){setOriginal(false);return;}
 if(action==='replay'){mounted.querySelector('.v030-reward').hidden=true;state.rhythmHit=0;state.rhythmLast=-10;state.rhythmPulseTime=-100;state.stageDoneNow=false;const native=document.getElementById('rhythm-progress');if(native)native.textContent='0';previousHits=0;mounted.querySelector('.v030-room')?.classList.remove('v034-hit-flash');return;}
 if(action==='next'){selectStage('s12');return;}
 if(action==='push'){const before=state.rhythmHit;document.getElementById('pushSwing')?.click();const after=state.rhythmHit;
   if(after>before){mounted.querySelector('.v030-room')?.classList.remove('v034-hit-flash');void mounted.querySelector('.v030-room')?.offsetWidth;mounted.querySelector('.v030-room')?.classList.add('v034-hit-flash');mounted.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('furiko:resonance-hit',{bubbles:true,detail:{hits:after}}));}
   if(after>before){mounted.querySelector('.v030-message').textContent='成功！ さっきより揺れが大きくなった！';}else{mounted.querySelector('.v030-message').textContent='惜しい！ 真ん中を通過する瞬間に押そう。';}return;}
}
function draw(now){if(!mounted?.isConnected || !alive()){raf=0;return;}raf=requestAnimationFrame(draw);
 const room=mounted.querySelector('.v030-room');if(room.hidden)return;
 const canvas=room.querySelector('canvas'),rect=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();if(!rect.width||!rect.height)return;
 const dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2),W=rect.width,H=rect.height;
 if(canvas.width!==Math.round(W*dpr)||canvas.height!==Math.round(H*dpr)){canvas.width=Math.round(W*dpr);canvas.height=Math.round(H*dpr);}
 const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
 const nowS=performance.now()/1000,phase=2*Math.PI*nowS/T(),near=Math.abs(Math.sin(phase))>=.89;
 const hits=Math.min(Number(state.rhythmHit)||0,4),angle=.16+hits*.055;
 const centers=W<720?[.31,.69]:[.39,.64];
 for(let j=0;j<2;j++){
  const cx=W*centers[j],py=H*(W<720?.215:.16),len=Math.min(H*.315,W*.49),a=(j===0?1:-1)*angle*Math.cos(phase+(j===1?.04:0)),x=cx+len*Math.sin(a),y=py+len*Math.cos(a);
  const tint=j===0?'#ffe3a3':'#b9edff';
  ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=W<720?.84:.93;ctx.strokeStyle=tint;ctx.lineWidth=Math.max(2,W/700);ctx.shadowColor=tint;ctx.shadowBlur=14;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(cx,py);ctx.lineTo(x,y);ctx.stroke();ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,py,4,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle='#fff1ca';ctx.fill();
  const r=Math.max(10,Math.min(30,W*.025));const grad=ctx.createRadialGradient(x-r*.37,y-r*.4,1,x,y,r*1.4);grad.addColorStop(0,'#fffbdf');grad.addColorStop(.36,j===0?'#e6b75a':'#8bd4e9');grad.addColorStop(1,'#1c3651');
  ctx.fillStyle=grad;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.strokeStyle=tint;ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();
 }
 const sig=room.querySelector('.v030-signal');sig.dataset.ready=near?'true':'false';sig.textContent=hits>=4?'✨ 光が満ちた！':near?'● 今がチャンス！ 押す！':'◯ 真ん中に来たら押そう';
 room.querySelector('.v030-hit').textContent=`成功 ${hits} / 4`;room.querySelector('.v030-meter > i').style.width=(hits*25)+'%';
 room.querySelector('.v030-push').disabled=hits>=4;
 if(hits>=4&&!room.querySelector('.v030-reward').dataset.dismissed){room.querySelector('.v030-reward').hidden=false;}
 if(hits<4){room.querySelector('.v030-reward').hidden=true;room.querySelector('.v030-reward').dataset.dismissed='';}
 previousHits=hits;
}
function mount(vp){if(mounted===vp)return;mounted=vp;vp.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',html);const restore=document.createElement('button');restore.className='v030-restore';restore.hidden=true;restore.type='button';restore.dataset.v030='restore';restore.textContent='✦ 共振の広間を開く';vp.appendChild(restore);vp.classList.add('v030-open');document.body.classList.add('v030-immersive');vp.addEventListener('click',onClick);vp.querySelector('.v030-period').textContent=T().toFixed(2);previousHits=state.rhythmHit||0;if(!raf)raf=requestAnimationFrame(draw);}
function check(){const vp=document.querySelector('#app .stage-viewport');if(alive()&&vp){if(!vp.querySelector('.v030-room')){mounted=null;mount(vp)}}else{document.body.classList.remove('v030-immersive');if(mounted&&!mounted.isConnected)mounted=null;}}
const shortcut=document.createElement('button');shortcut.className='v030-shortcut';shortcut.type='button';shortcut.textContent='✦ 共振の広間（新しい画面）を体験';shortcut.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.view='world';selectStage('s11');});document.body.appendChild(shortcut);
setInterval(check,360);check();
})();
</script>

<style id="v031-exploration-style">
/* v0.31: Stage 11 actual in-world exploration wired to existing stage 11 timing evaluator. */
body.v031-active .v030-shortcut{display:none!important}

body.v030-immersive .v030-hall-head{top:19px}
.v031-room{position:absolute;inset:0;min-height:100svh;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;z-index:300;color:#fef2d9;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN",sans-serif;touch-action:pan-y}

.v031-scenery:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#04101fa8 0%,#001a2809 31%,#08172305 56%,#04101cdb 98%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 18% 60%,#010a18b0,transparent 43%);pointer-events:none}
.v031-haze{position:absolute;inset:-4%;z-index:-2;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 35%,#fff9d517,transparent 42%),linear-gradient(90deg,#020b1991,transparent 35% 65%,#04101982);transform:translateX(var(--v31-mid,0px));}
.v031-floor{position:absolute;z-index:-1;inset:68% -15% -17%;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#cfae6500,#e9cd8729 53%,#0a25396a);clip-path:polygon(32% 0,68% 0,100% 100%,0 100%);transform:translateX(var(--v31-floor,0px));opacity:.65}
.v031-floor:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,#fff0b500 0 34px,#f0d6a226 35px 37px,#fff0b500 38px 86px)}
.v031-sparks{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:1;background:radial-gradient(circle at 44% 45%,#ffe9b43d 0 2px,transparent 3px),radial-gradient(circle at 70% 39%,#e2f7ff45 0 2px,transparent 3px),radial-gradient(circle at 55% 71%,#fff0ac65 0 2px,transparent 3px);animation:v031-spark 7s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes v031-spark{to{opacity:.3;transform:translateY(-18px)}}
.v031-halo{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 59% 54%,#ffe9a52d 0 6%,transparent 38%);filter:blur(9px)}
.v031-header{position:absolute;top:clamp(15px,3vh,34px);left:clamp(10px,2.5vw,36px);right:clamp(10px,2.5vw,36px);z-index:14;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;pointer-events:none}
.v031-heading{pointer-events:none;max-width:550px;padding:15px 20px;border-left:3px solid #ffe6a4;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#05101fe9,#071524ac,transparent);text-shadow:0 2px 9px #000b;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 10px #0008)}
.v031-heading small{font-size:11px;color:#ffe9ac;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.15em}
.v031-heading h2{margin:4px 0 2px;font-size:clamp(23px,3.2vw,35px);font-weight:900;line-height:1.23;color:#fff5d7}

.v031-top-actions{display:flex;gap:7px;pointer-events:auto}
.v031-top-actions button,.v031-bottom button,.v031-dialog button,.v031-marker{cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation}
.v031-top-actions button{border-radius:13px;border:1px solid #e9c989b3;min-width:66px;min-height:48px;white-space:nowrap;background:#071928c9;color:#fff3d6;font:800 12px system-ui;box-shadow:0 3px 15px #0009;backdrop-filter:blur(9px)}
.v031-top-actions button span{display:block;font-size:19px;line-height:1.1;margin-bottom:3px}
.v031-target{position:absolute;left:58%;top:49%;z-index:6;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border:1px solid #ffe1a6df;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#0d1b26e9,#243336e5);color:#fff0c7;border-radius:100px;padding:11px 15px;box-shadow:0 6px 24px #000e,0 0 22px #f5c77888;font-weight:900;font-size:14px;white-space:nowrap;animation:v031-target-glow 2.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.v031-target:before{content:"◈";display:inline-block;margin-right:7px;color:#ffe5a1}
@keyframes v031-target-glow{to{box-shadow:0 7px 25px #000d,0 0 39px #f5c778e3}}
.v031-target[aria-current="true"]{background:linear-gradient(130deg,#fbe7ba,#b68a4b);color:#152a36}
.v031-platform{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:57%;top:69%;width:clamp(150px,23%,340px);height:16px;transform:translateX(-50%);border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,#ffffa960 1%,#ffc8684b 39%,transparent 75%);pointer-events:none;filter:blur(1px)}
.v031-platform:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-18px 0;border:2px solid #ffdb8b55;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 25px #e5b5655e}
.v031-player{position:absolute;left:var(--v31-x,29%);top:var(--v31-y,76%);bottom:auto!important;z-index:5!important;width:clamp(150px,16vw,230px);height:auto!important;transform:translate(-50%,-100%) scale(var(--v31-scale,1));pointer-events:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 13px #000d) drop-shadow(0 0 18px #ffdda635);transition:filter .15s}
.v031-player.walking .exp22-figure{animation:exp22-walk .29s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.v031-player[data-facing="left"] .exp22-figure{transform:scaleX(-1)}

.v031-player svg,.v031-player img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;overflow:visible}

@keyframes v031-float{to{transform:translateY(-12px)}}
.v031-shadow{position:absolute;left:var(--v31-x,29%);top:var(--v31-y,76%);width:102px;height:20px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border-radius:50%;z-index:3;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,#000b18e0,#091a29a8 48%,transparent 73%);filter:blur(5px)}
.v031-status{position:absolute;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);bottom:calc(132px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));z-index:10;max-width:min(540px,90vw);min-width:220px;pointer-events:none;text-align:center;background:#061626dc;border:1px solid #eccb8996;border-radius:13px;padding:10px 16px;font-size:12px;font-weight:750;box-shadow:0 5px 18px #0009}
.v031-bottom{position:absolute;inset:auto clamp(9px,2vw,30px) calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));z-index:15;display:flex;gap:13px;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;pointer-events:none}
.v031-objective{background:linear-gradient(115deg,#051325df,#122f39bd);padding:12px 15px 14px;border-radius:13px;border:1px solid #d7b5758c;max-width:270px;box-shadow:0 4px 22px #0009;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.v031-objective strong{font-size:13px;color:#ffe2a0}.v031-objective span{display:block;font-size:11px;margin-top:5px;line-height:1.55}
.v031-controls{display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:center;gap:9px;pointer-events:auto}

.v031-controls button b{display:block;font-size:23px;margin-bottom:3px}
.v031-pad{pointer-events:auto;flex:none;width:clamp(110px,12.5vw,150px);height:clamp(110px,12.5vw,150px);border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #edd69b8c;background:radial-gradient(circle,#23394dca 20%,#061423dc 70%);box-shadow:0 7px 30px #000b,inset 0 0 14px #f4dfb42e;position:relative;touch-action:none;cursor:grab;user-select:none}
.v031-pad:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:27%;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#f3e9d7,#a8b8c9);border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #fff6dc;box-shadow:0 0 8px #0009;transform:translate(var(--v31-knob-x,0px),var(--v31-knob-y,0px));}
.v031-pad:before{content:"▲";position:absolute;left:50%;top:8%;transform:translateX(-50%);color:#ffe7b2;font-size:14px;white-space:pre}
.v031-dialog{position:absolute;z-index:40;left:50%;top:48%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:min(420px,calc(100vw - 25px));padding:24px;border:2px solid #f6d18e;border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#07172bf4,#183744f5);box-shadow:0 8px 50px #000e;text-align:left;backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.v031-dialog[hidden]{display:none!important}.v031-dialog h3{color:#ffe2a0;margin:0 0 8px}.v031-dialog p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.85}.v031-dialog button{display:block;width:100%;margin-top:10px;padding:12px;border-radius:12px;color:#18313a;font-weight:900;background:#f8dda4;border:1px solid #fff5d5}
.v031-room button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #77e6ff;outline-offset:3px}
.v031-room.v031-completed .v031-halo{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 56% 46%,#fff1a57f 0 12%,transparent 55%)}
.v031-room.v031-completed .v031-target{border-color:#c6ffd0;box-shadow:0 0 40px #c9ffe3a8}
@media(max-width:1030px){.v031-objective{display:none}.v031-bottom{justify-content:space-between}.v031-top-actions button{min-width:56px}}
@media(max-width:760px){
 .v031-room{min-height:100svh}
 .v031-scenery{background-position:50% 52%;filter:saturate(1.13) contrast(1.05)}
 .v031-header{top:14px;left:8px;right:8px}.v031-heading{padding:9px 12px;max-width:58%;}.v031-heading small{font-size:8px}.v031-heading h2{font-size:17px}.v031-heading p{font-size:10px}
 .v031-top-actions{gap:5px}.v031-top-actions button{min-width:43px;min-height:44px;padding:5px 6px;font-size:9px;border-radius:9px}.v031-top-actions button span{font-size:17px}
 .v031-target{top:46%;left:59%;font-size:12px;padding:9px 10px;max-width:70%;white-space:normal}
 .v031-platform{top:65%;left:57%;width:130px}.v031-player{width:165px}.v031-companion{width:35px;height:42px}
 .v031-status{bottom:calc(110px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));font-size:10px;padding:8px 11px;min-width:0;width:max-content;max-width:90vw}
 .v031-bottom{bottom:calc(7px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));left:8px;right:8px;gap:7px}
 .v031-pad{width:100px;height:100px}.v031-controls{gap:5px}.v031-controls button{min-height:58px;min-width:47px;font-size:10px;border-radius:13px;padding:6px}.v031-controls button b{font-size:20px}
}
@media(max-width:360px){.v031-heading{max-width:55%}.v031-heading h2{font-size:16px}.v031-top-actions button{min-width:40px}.v031-controls button{min-width:43px}.v031-pad{width:90px;height:90px}.v031-status{bottom:105px}.v031-target{top:42%}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.v031-sparks,.v031-companion,.v031-target{animation:none!important}}
</style>
<script id="v031-exploration-script">
(()=>{'use strict';
 const sleepNoop=()=>{};
 const isCurrent=()=>{try{return document.body.dataset.scene==='world'&&state.view==='world'&&state.sid==='s11'}catch(_){return false}};
 const clamp=(x,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,x));
 const actor=String.raw`<div class="exp22-figure v033-actor"><img class="v033-part v033-cape" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="" draggable="false" /><img class="v033-part v033-leg_left" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="" draggable="false" /><img class="v033-part v033-leg_right" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="" draggable="false" /><img class="v033-part v033-arm" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="" draggable="false" /><img class="v033-part v033-body" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="" draggable="false" /></div>`;
 const markup=`<div class="v031-room" aria-label="共振の広間の探索" data-version="0.36">
 <div class="v031-scenery" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="v031-haze" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="v031-halo" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="v031-floor" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="v031-sparks" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="v032-light-path" aria-hidden="true"><i></i><i></i><i></i></div><div class="v032-aura" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="v031-platform" aria-hidden="true"></div>
 <header class="v031-header"><div class="v031-heading"><small>STAGE 11 · RESONANCE HALL</small><h2>共振の広間</h2><p>揺れは、つながって広がる。</p></div>
 <nav class="v031-top-actions" aria-label="ゲームメニュー"><button data-v031="map" type="button"><span>▧</span>マップ</button><button data-v031="note" type="button"><span>▤</span>図鑑</button><button data-v031="hint" type="button"><span>✧</span>ヒント</button></nav></header>
 <canvas class="v034-physics-canvas" aria-hidden="true"></canvas><div class="v034-physics-caption" aria-live="off">時計塔の小さな共振装置 <span>装置に触れると振り子が動き出す</span></div><button class="v031-target" type="button" data-v031="target" aria-label="時計塔の操作台へ向かう">操作台へ近づく</button>
 <div class="v036-console" data-v036-device="resonance" aria-label="振り子を動かす時計塔の操作台">
    <div class="v036-console-light" aria-hidden="true"></div>
    <div class="v036-control-pillar" aria-hidden="true"><div class="v036-lever"><span></span></div><div class="v036-dial"><i></i></div><div class="v036-slot"></div></div>
    <button type="button" class="v036-activate" data-v031="target" aria-label="振り子の操作台を調べる"><span class="v036-action-icon" aria-hidden="true">✋</span><span>操作台</span></button>
    <div class="v036-console-foot" aria-hidden="true"></div>
   </div>
   <svg class="v036-touch-link" aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path class="v036-touch-link-back"/><path class="v036-touch-link-front"/></svg>
   <div class="v033-contact" aria-hidden="true"><span class="v033-touch-ring"></span><span class="v033-beam"></span><span class="v033-particle p1">✦</span><span class="v033-particle p2">✧</span><span class="v033-particle p3">✦</span></div><div class="v036-ground-texture" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="v036-floor-reflection" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="v036-foot-trail" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="v031-shadow" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="v032-step-glow" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="v031-player exp22-character" data-facing="right" role="img" aria-label="時計塔を探索する主人公">${actor}</div>
 <svg class="v031-companion" viewBox="0 0 90 100" aria-hidden="true"><defs><radialGradient id="v31blue"><stop stop-color="#fff"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#baffff"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#3fb9ff"/></radialGradient></defs><path d="M37 26 Q12 -9 8 15Q3 32 29 42" fill="#99f2ff" stroke="#e8ffff" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M55 24 Q86 -8 87 17Q91 33 65 45" fill="#c1ecff" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="3"/><ellipse cx="46" cy="56" rx="25" ry="26" fill="url(#v31blue)" stroke="#f6ffff" stroke-width="3"/><circle cx="37" cy="52" r="3" fill="#15445d"/><circle cx="55" cy="52" r="3" fill="#15445d"/><path d="M41 65Q46 69 51 65" fill="none" stroke="#15445d" stroke-width="2.5"/><path d="M22 72 Q-3 88 6 90L33 79 M67 71Q98 88 84 93L57 80" stroke="#9af4ff" stroke-width="5" fill="none"/></svg>
 <div class="v032-quest-progress" aria-live="off">タイミング成功 <b>0 / 4</b><i></i></div><div class="v031-status" role="status" aria-live="polite">動いて近づこう。光る操作台に近づき、「調べる」を押そう。</div>
 <div class="v031-bottom"><div class="v031-objective"><strong>◆ クエスト目標</strong><span>操作台から振り子を動かし、同じ周期の装置が大きく揺れる条件を見つけよう。</span></div>
  <div class="v031-pad" role="group" aria-label="移動スティック" title="押しながら移動"></div>
  <div class="v031-controls"><button type="button" data-v031="inspect"><b>✋</b>調べる</button><button type="button" data-v031="experiment"><b>⚙</b>しかけ</button><button type="button" data-v031="note"><b>▤</b>ノート</button><button type="button" data-v031="hint"><b>✧</b>ヒント</button></div></div>
 <div class="v031-dialog" hidden role="dialog" aria-modal="false"><h3 class="v031-dialog-title"></h3><p class="v031-dialog-message"></p><button type="button" data-v031="close">冒険にもどる</button></div>
 </div>`;
 let viewport=null,room=null,x=.29,y=.78,lastTime=0,frameId=0,keys=new Set(),padDir=[0,0],autoGoal=null,paused=false,mode='explore';
 let camX=0,camY=0,compX=.20,compY=.66,walking=false,lastActive=false,walkTime=0,displayHits=-1,contactTimer=0,contacting=false;
 const reduceMotion=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
 function say(message){const t=room?.querySelector('.v031-status');if(t && t.textContent!==message)t.textContent=message}
 function distance(){return Math.hypot((x-.58)*1.25,(y-.82)*1.5)}
 function isNear(){return distance()<=.19}
 function apply(dt=0){if(!room)return;
  const mobile=innerWidth<=760;
  // Keep the hero's feet anchored to the same floor point while depth changes.
  const depth=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(y-.50)/.41));
  const scale=.73+depth*.58;
  const desiredCam=(x-.49)*(mobile?190:280);
  const desiredY=(y-.75)*(mobile?24:38);
  const lerp=(dt===0||reduceMotion)?1:Math.min(1,dt*3.5);
  camX+=(desiredCam-camX)*lerp;camY+=(desiredY-camY)*lerp;
  const far=-camX*.24,mid=-camX*.47,nearShift=-camX*.68;
  room.style.setProperty('--v31-x',(x*100).toFixed(2)+'%');
  room.style.setProperty('--v31-y',(y*100).toFixed(2)+'%');
  room.style.setProperty('--v31-scale',scale.toFixed(3));
  room.style.setProperty('--v31-far',far.toFixed(1)+'px');
  room.style.setProperty('--v31-mid',mid.toFixed(1)+'px');
  room.style.setProperty('--v31-floor',nearShift.toFixed(1)+'px');
  room.style.setProperty('--v32-near',nearShift.toFixed(1)+'px');
  room.style.setProperty('--v32-cam-y',(-camY*.26).toFixed(1)+'px');
  room.style.setProperty('--v32-step-size',(scale*.9).toFixed(2));
  room.style.setProperty('--v32-ground-fade',(0.53+depth*.32).toFixed(2));
  // The familiar follows with a delay instead of teleporting with the character.
  const wantCompX=x-(mobile?.10:.065),wantCompY=y-(mobile?.13:.10);
  const following=(dt===0||reduceMotion)?1:Math.min(1,dt*4.2);
  compX+=(wantCompX-compX)*following;compY+=(wantCompY-compY)*following;
  room.style.setProperty('--v32-familiar-x',(compX*100).toFixed(2)+'%');
  room.style.setProperty('--v32-familiar-y',(compY*100).toFixed(2)+'%');
  const target=room.querySelector('.v031-target');
  const near=isNear();room.classList.toggle('v033-near',near);target?.setAttribute('aria-current',String(near));
  if(target)target.textContent=near?'✋ 操作台を調べる':'操作台へ近づく';
  const hit=state.rhythmHit||0;
  if(hit!==displayHits){displayHits=hit;const prog=room.querySelector('.v032-quest-progress b');if(prog)prog.textContent=Math.min(4,hit)+' / 4';}
  room.classList.toggle('v031-completed',hit>=4);
 }
 function frame(time){frameId=requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  if(!room?.isConnected||!isCurrent()||mode!=='explore'||room.hidden||paused){lastTime=time;return}
  const dt=clamp((time-(lastTime||time))/1000,0,.045);lastTime=time;
  let dx=0,dy=0;
  if(keys.has('ArrowLeft')||keys.has('a'))dx--;
  if(keys.has('ArrowRight')||keys.has('d'))dx++;
  if(keys.has('ArrowUp')||keys.has('w'))dy--;
  if(keys.has('ArrowDown')||keys.has('s'))dy++;
  dx+=padDir[0];dy+=padDir[1];
  if(autoGoal){const gx=autoGoal[0]-x,gy=autoGoal[1]-y;const dist=Math.hypot(gx,gy);
   if(dist<.012){autoGoal=null;dx=0;dy=0;walking=false;beginContact();return}
   else{dx=gx/dist;dy=gy/dist;}}
  const inputMagnitude=Math.hypot(dx,dy);walking=inputMagnitude>.08;
  const player=room.querySelector('.v031-player');
  player?.classList.toggle('walking',walking);
  room.classList.toggle('v032-walking',walking);
  if(walking){
   const speed=(autoGoal?.30:.225)*dt;
   x=clamp(x+dx/inputMagnitude*speed,.12,.87);
   y=clamp(y+dy/inputMagnitude*speed,.50,.91);
   if(player){if(Math.abs(dx)>.18){player.dataset.facing=dx<0?'left':'right';player.style.setProperty('--v32-flip',dx<0?'-1':'1');}player.style.setProperty('--v32-lean',((dx/inputMagnitude)*2.5).toFixed(2)+'deg');}
   walkTime+=dt;room.style.setProperty('--v33-step',((Math.sin(walkTime*19)+1)/2).toFixed(3));
  }else if(player)player.style.setProperty('--v32-lean','0deg');
  apply(dt);
 }
 function cancelContact(){clearTimeout(contactTimer);contactTimer=0;contacting=false;room?.classList.remove('v033-interacting');}
 function beginContact(){
  if(!room||room.hidden||!isCurrent()||contacting)return;
  if(!isNear()){startApproach();return;}
  contacting=true;paused=true;walking=false;keys.clear();padReset();autoGoal=null;
   room.dataset.v034Started='true';room.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('furiko:resonance-contact',{bubbles:true,detail:{stage:'s11'}}));
  const player=room.querySelector('.v031-player');player?.classList.remove('walking');
  room.classList.remove('v032-walking');room.classList.add('v033-interacting');
  say('主人公が操作台のレバーに手を伸ばした…！');
  // A full in-world contact beat before the existing scientific experiment opens.
  contactTimer=window.setTimeout(()=>{contactTimer=0;contacting=false;
    room?.classList.remove('v033-interacting');paused=false;
    if(isCurrent()&&room&&!room.hidden)openExperiment();
  },reduceMotion?160:930);
 }
 function openDialog(title,message){const dialog=room.querySelector('.v031-dialog');dialog.querySelector('.v031-dialog-title').textContent=title;dialog.querySelector('.v031-dialog-message').textContent=message;dialog.hidden=false;paused=true;keys.clear();padDir=[0,0]}
 function closeDialog(){room.querySelector('.v031-dialog').hidden=true;paused=false}
 function openExperiment(){if(!viewport||!isCurrent())return;cancelContact();closeDialog();mode='experiment';autoGoal=null;room.hidden=true;walking=false;viewport.classList.remove('v031-exploring');document.body.classList.remove('v031-active');const native=viewport.querySelector('.v030-room');if(native){native.hidden=false;viewport.classList.add('v030-open');viewport.classList.remove('v030-original');}document.body.classList.add('v030-immersive')}
 function openExploration(){if(!viewport||!isCurrent())return;cancelContact();mode='explore';lastTime=0;room.hidden=false;walking=false;viewport.classList.add('v031-exploring','v030-open');viewport.classList.remove('v030-original');document.body.classList.add('v031-active','v030-immersive');viewport.querySelector('.v030-reward')?.setAttribute('data-dismissed','');apply();room.classList.toggle('v033-victory',state.rhythmHit>=4);say(state.rhythmHit>=4?'実験成功！ 次のステージへ進むか、自由に探索できるよ。':'動いて近づこう。光る操作台に近づき、「調べる」を押そう。')}
 function inspect(){if(isNear()){beginContact()}else{say('もう少し近づこう。光る振り子をタップすれば自動で近づけるよ。')}}
 function startApproach(){if(contacting)return;closeDialog();autoGoal=[innerWidth<=760?.50:.55,.83];say('操作台へ向かっています…')}
 function act(e){const b=e.target.closest('[data-v031]');if(!b)return;const action=b.dataset.v031;if(action==='close'){closeDialog();return}if(action==='map'){selectTab('map');return}
  if(action==='hint'){openDialog('科学のヒント','振り子が中央を通る瞬間に、揺れを強める向きへ押してみよう。タイミングを変えて、振れ幅がどうなるか観察しよう。');return}
  if(action==='note'){openDialog('発見ノート：共振','物体には揺れやすい固有の周期があります。その周期に合わせて力を繰り返し加えると、振れ幅が大きくなることがあります。これを「共振」といいます。ゲームでは、真ん中を通るタイミングで押すと揺れが大きくなる仕組みを体験します。共振装置の短い振り子は周期が異なるので、同じリズムで押しても大きく揺れません。画面は違いが分かるように強調した模式図です。');return}
  if(action==='experiment'||action==='target'){if(isNear())beginContact();else startApproach();return}if(action==='inspect')inspect();}
 function padMove(e){if(!room)return;const el=room.querySelector('.v031-pad');const rect=el.getBoundingClientRect(),centerX=rect.left+rect.width/2,centerY=rect.top+rect.height/2;const dx=e.clientX-centerX,dy=e.clientY-centerY,mag=Math.hypot(dx,dy);padDir=mag<12?[0,0]:[dx/Math.max(mag,1),dy/Math.max(mag,1)];el.style.setProperty('--v31-knob-x',clamp(dx,-20,20)+'px');el.style.setProperty('--v31-knob-y',clamp(dy,-20,20)+'px');autoGoal=null}
 function padReset(){padDir=[0,0];if(room){const el=room.querySelector('.v031-pad');el?.style.setProperty('--v31-knob-x','0px');el?.style.setProperty('--v31-knob-y','0px')}}
 function mount(v){viewport=v;y=window.innerWidth>760?.9:.83;camX=0;camY=0;compX=x-.1;compY=y-.13;displayHits=-1;v.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',markup);room=v.querySelector('.v031-room');const art=v.querySelector('.v030-scenery');const bg=art&&getComputedStyle(art).backgroundImage;const scenery=room.querySelector('.v031-scenery');if(bg)scenery.style.backgroundImage=bg.split(', url(').length>1?'url('+bg.split(', url(').pop():bg; // The source CSS already has a gradient + embedded image.
  v.querySelector('.v030-actions')?.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin','<button type="button" data-v031-return>↩ 探索へ</button>');const older=v.querySelector('[data-v030=original]');if(older)older.textContent='☷ 旧実験';
  v.addEventListener('click',(e)=>{if(e.target.closest('[data-v031-return]'))openExploration()});room.addEventListener('click',act);const pad=room.querySelector('.v031-pad');pad.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{e.preventDefault();pad.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);padMove(e)});pad.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(pad.hasPointerCapture(e.pointerId))padMove(e)});pad.addEventListener('pointerup',padReset);pad.addEventListener('pointercancel',padReset);openExploration();if(!frameId)frameId=requestAnimationFrame(frame);
 }
 function watch(){const v=document.querySelector('#app .stage-viewport');if(isCurrent()&&v?.querySelector('.v030-room')){if(!v.querySelector('.v031-room'))mount(v);else if(viewport!==v){viewport=v;room=v.querySelector('.v031-room');openExploration()}}else{document.body.classList.remove('v031-active');if(viewport&&!viewport.isConnected){cancelContact();viewport=null;room=null;mode='explore';keys.clear();padDir=[0,0];autoGoal=null;lastTime=0}}}
 window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(!room||mode!=='explore'||!isCurrent()||paused)return;if(['INPUT','TEXTAREA','SELECT'].includes(document.activeElement?.tagName))return;const k=e.key.startsWith('Arrow')?e.key:e.key.toLowerCase();if(['ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','w','a','s','d'].includes(k)){keys.add(k);autoGoal=null;e.preventDefault()}if(k==='Enter'&&document.activeElement?.tagName!=='BUTTON'){inspect();e.preventDefault()}});
 window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{const k=e.key.startsWith('Arrow')?e.key:e.key.toLowerCase();keys.delete(k)});
 window.addEventListener('blur',()=>{keys.clear();padReset()});
 setInterval(watch,240);watch();
})();
</script>
<style id="v032-polish-style">
/* v0.32: depth-linked grounding, softened parallax, actual responsive input feedback. */
.v031-room{--v32-near:0px;--v32-familiar-x:19%;--v32-familiar-y:64%;}
.v031-room{height:100dvh;min-height:0!important;max-height:100dvh;}
.v032-ground-photo{display:none;pointer-events:none;}
.v031-scenery{transform:translate3d(var(--v31-far,0px),var(--v32-cam-y,0px),0) scale(1.1);will-change:transform;}
.v031-haze{transform:translate3d(var(--v31-mid,0px),0,0);}
.v031-floor{transform:translate3d(var(--v31-floor,0px),0,0);opacity:.43;}
.v031-player{width:clamp(130px,11vw,170px)!important;transform:translate(-50%,-100%) scale(var(--v31-scale,1));transform-origin:50% 100%;will-change:left,top,transform;filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 11px #000c) drop-shadow(0 0 14px #ffd37521)}
.v031-player .exp22-figure{display:block;transform-origin:50% 90%;transform:scaleX(var(--v32-flip,1)) rotate(var(--v32-lean,0deg));will-change:transform}
.v031-player.walking .exp22-figure{animation:v032-stride .34s ease-in-out infinite alternate!important;}
@keyframes v032-stride{
  from{transform:scaleX(var(--v32-flip,1)) translateY(0) rotate(calc(var(--v32-lean,0deg) - 2deg)) skewX(-1deg)}
  to{transform:scaleX(var(--v32-flip,1)) translateY(-5px) rotate(calc(var(--v32-lean,0deg) + 2deg)) skewX(1deg)}
}
.v031-shadow{width:90px;height:18px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(var(--v31-scale,1));opacity:var(--v32-ground-fade,.75);filter:blur(6px)}
.v032-step-glow{position:absolute;left:var(--v31-x,29%);top:var(--v31-y,76%);z-index:4;width:46px;height:9px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(var(--v32-step-size,1));border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,#fff3cb76 0%,#f1bb7657 32%,transparent 72%);opacity:.24;pointer-events:none}
.v032-walking .v032-step-glow{animation:v032-footlight .34s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes v032-footlight{from{opacity:.18;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.8)}to{opacity:.7;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.4)}}
.v031-companion{left:var(--v32-familiar-x,19%);top:var(--v32-familiar-y,64%);will-change:left,top;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px #82dfff) drop-shadow(0 0 6px #faffff)}
.v032-light-path{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:1;transform:translateX(var(--v32-near,0px));opacity:.67}
.v032-light-path i{position:absolute;display:block;top:68%;left:57%;width:min(32vw,230px);height:34px;border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border:1px solid #ffe9ad70;box-shadow:0 0 13px #f6cc7b4a;animation:v032-arc 4s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.v032-light-path i:nth-child(2){width:min(25vw,185px);height:21px;animation-delay:-1s;border-color:#fff7d255}
.v032-light-path i:nth-child(3){width:min(18vw,135px);height:10px;animation-delay:-2s;border-color:#b4f5ff55}
@keyframes v032-arc{to{opacity:.35;filter:blur(2px);transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.09)}}
.v032-aura{position:absolute;left:57%;top:31%;z-index:2;width:min(29vw,240px);height:min(30vh,240px);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,#ffeba71b,transparent 69%);mix-blend-mode:screen;animation:v032-breath 2.6s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes v032-breath{to{opacity:.35;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.2)}}
.v031-room.v031-completed .v032-aura{background:radial-gradient(ellipse,#fff3c376,#f4cc7438,transparent 75%);}
.v032-quest-progress{position:absolute;top:clamp(120px,18%,190px);left:clamp(12px,2.5vw,36px);z-index:12;background:#061725b8;border:1px solid #edcf8c9a;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 12px;font:700 11px system-ui;color:#e8f1ee;pointer-events:none;box-shadow:0 4px 14px #0009;}
.v032-quest-progress b{color:#ffe09a;font-size:12px}.v032-quest-progress i{display:inline-block;width:7px;height:7px;background:#fbd687;border-radius:50%;margin-left:5px;box-shadow:0 0 10px #fce9a9;}
.v031-target{transform:translate(calc(-50% + var(--v31-far,0px)), -50%);}
.v031-room button:active{filter:brightness(1.25)}
@media(min-width:761px){
 .v032-ground-photo{display:block;position:absolute;inset:67% 0 0;z-index:3;background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,);background-size:100% 100%;background-position:center bottom;background-repeat:no-repeat;transform:translateX(calc(var(--v31-floor,0px) * .32)) scale(1.04);}
 .v031-room .v031-floor{opacity:.19}
}
@media(max-width:760px){
 .v031-player{width:clamp(103px,27vw,115px)!important}
 .v031-companion{width:37px;height:44px}
 .v032-quest-progress{top:112px;left:8px;font-size:10px;padding:6px 9px;}
 .v031-target{top:45%;}
 .v032-aura{top:32%;width:42vw;height:25vh}
 .v032-light-path i{top:70%}
 .v031-status{background:#071423c2}
}
@media(max-width:360px){.v032-quest-progress{top:145px}.v031-heading small{font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.02em;white-space:nowrap}.v031-player{width:103px!important}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.v031-player.walking .exp22-figure,.v032-light-path i,.v032-aura,.v032-step-glow{animation:none!important}}
</style>
<style id="v033-character-rig-style">
/* v0.33 segmented character: independent cape, leg and arm motion. */
.v031-player .v033-actor {position:relative;display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:231 / 401;transform-origin:50% 88%;will-change:transform}
.v031-player .v033-actor .v033-part{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;pointer-events:none;will-change:transform;max-width:none;max-height:none}
.v033-actor .v033-cape{z-index:0;transform-origin:66% 24%;animation:v033-cape-idle 3s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.v033-actor .v033-leg_left{z-index:1;transform-origin:61% 60%}
.v033-actor .v033-leg_right{z-index:2;transform-origin:75% 60%}
.v033-actor .v033-body{z-index:3}
.v033-actor .v033-arm{z-index:4;transform-origin:80% 35%}
.v031-player.walking .v033-actor{animation:v033-walk-body .33s ease-in-out infinite alternate!important}
.v031-player.walking .v033-leg_left{animation:v033-leg-left .36s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.v031-player.walking .v033-leg_right{animation:v033-leg-right .36s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.v031-player.walking .v033-arm{animation:v033-hand-swing .36s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.v031-player.walking .v033-cape{animation:v033-cape-walk .42s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes v033-walk-body {from{transform:scaleX(var(--v32-flip,1)) translateY(1px) rotate(calc(var(--v32-lean,0deg) - 1deg))}to{transform:scaleX(var(--v32-flip,1)) translateY(-3px) rotate(calc(var(--v32-lean,0deg) + 1deg))}}
@keyframes v033-leg-left {from{transform:rotate(-6deg) translateX(-2px)}to{transform:rotate(8deg) translateX(2px)}}
@keyframes v033-leg-right {from{transform:rotate(7deg) translateX(2px)}to{transform:rotate(-7deg) translateX(-2px)}}
@keyframes v033-hand-swing {from{transform:rotate(-5deg)}to{transform:rotate(7deg)}}
@keyframes v033-cape-idle {from{transform:rotate(-1.6deg) translateX(-1px)}to{transform:rotate(1.4deg) translateX(2px)}}
@keyframes v033-cape-walk {from{transform:rotate(-5deg) translate(-1px,1px)}to{transform:rotate(5deg) translate(3px,-1px)}}
.v031-room.v033-interacting .v031-player{transition:left .2s,top .2s,filter .2s;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 11px #f4d390) drop-shadow(0 7px 12px #000d)}
.v031-room.v033-interacting .v033-actor{animation:v033-reach-body .93s ease-in-out both!important}
.v031-room.v033-interacting .v033-arm{animation:v033-reach-arm .93s cubic-bezier(.13,.78,.21,1) both!important}
.v031-room.v033-interacting .v033-cape{animation:v033-reach-cape .93s ease-in-out both!important}
.v031-room.v033-interacting .v033-leg_left,.v031-room.v033-interacting .v033-leg_right{animation:none!important}
@keyframes v033-reach-body{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) scaleX(var(--v32-flip,1))}20%{transform:translateY(-2px) scaleX(var(--v32-flip,1)) rotate(1deg)}55%{transform:translateY(1px) rotate(4deg)}80%{transform:translateY(-2px) rotate(4deg)}}
@keyframes v033-reach-arm{0%{transform:rotate(0deg)}34%{transform:rotate(-38deg)}70%{transform:rotate(-47deg)}100%{transform:rotate(-32deg)}}
@keyframes v033-reach-cape{0%{transform:rotate(0deg)}46%{transform:rotate(-8deg)}100%{transform:rotate(-4deg)}}
.v033-contact{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:9;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .18s}
.v031-room.v033-interacting .v033-contact{opacity:1}
.v033-touch-ring{position:absolute;left:58%;top:45%;width:min(40vw,210px);aspect-ratio:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.35);border:3px solid #fce4a9;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 25px #ffe3a98a,0 0 65px #fff0c47b,inset 0 0 15px #ffcb7c;animation:v033-ring .9s ease-out both;opacity:0}
.v031-room.v033-interacting .v033-touch-ring{animation:v033-ring .9s ease-out both}
@keyframes v033-ring{0%,14%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.35)}35%{opacity:.9}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.2)}}
.v033-beam{position:absolute;left:58%;top:44%;width:3px;height:25%;transform:rotate(-16deg);transform-origin:top center;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#d1faff,#fff1aa);box-shadow:0 0 14px #b6ecff,0 0 24px #ffe396;opacity:0;animation:none;}
.v031-room.v033-interacting .v033-beam{animation:v033-flash .9s ease-out}
@keyframes v033-flash{0%,30%{opacity:0}47%,70%{opacity:.9}100%{opacity:0}}
.v033-particle{position:absolute;left:58%;top:44%;color:#fff5cf;font-size:25px;text-shadow:0 0 14px #fff,0 0 22px #e8c771;opacity:0}
.v031-room.v033-interacting .v033-particle{animation:v033-star .85s ease-out both}
.v033-particle.p1{--spx:-55px;--spy:-50px}.v033-particle.p2{--spx:50px;--spy:-10px;animation-delay:.04s!important}.v033-particle.p3{--spx:3px;--spy:55px;animation-delay:.1s!important}
@keyframes v033-star{0%,18%{opacity:0;transform:translate(0,0) scale(.2)}40%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(var(--spx),var(--spy)) scale(1.1)}}
.v031-room.v033-interacting .v031-target{pointer-events:none}
.v031-room.v033-interacting .v031-status{border-color:#fff1bb;background:#162d3ef0;box-shadow:0 0 23px #fbd07d99}
.v031-room.v033-victory .v033-cape{animation:v033-cape-win 1.1s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes v033-cape-win{to{transform:rotate(7deg) translate(4px,-1px)}}
@media (max-width:760px){
 .v033-touch-ring{left:58%;top:44%;width:39vw}
 .v033-beam{left:58%;top:44%}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
 .v033-actor,.v033-part,.v033-touch-ring,.v033-particle,.v033-beam{animation:none!important}
 .v031-room.v033-interacting .v033-contact{opacity:.6}
 .v031-room.v033-interacting .v033-touch-ring{opacity:.65;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.65)}
}
